name: Foundation Phantom
summary: A bipedal humanoid with cycloid actuators from a US start-up that targets manufacturing, logistics and defence; there is no public way to buy one.

germany.statusNote: No sales route, price or distributor; the website only offers a newsletter sign-up. Foundation says it works with the US Department of Defense and its allies.

specs.label: Payload capacity
specs.value: 40 kg (one layout of the page shows 20 kg)
specs.conditions: conflicting values on the product page

specs.label: Max actuator peak torque
specs.conditions: legs >160 Nm, shoulder 119 Nm, wrist 20 Nm

notes: Payload figure is inconsistent on the maker page (40 kg vs 20 kg).
Hand type taken from the product image (five-finger hands); no hand specification published.
Foundation calls Phantom its "first production humanoid"; no customer deliveries were found.

images.alt: Foundation Phantom humanoid in black, standing, front view

evidence.task: Heavy-payload handling and a mortar demo shown in company videos
evidence.note: Video titles only (Mortar Demo May 2026, Heavy Payload Demo July 2026); the page does not say what the demos show.

openQuestions: Which payload value is correct, 40 kg or 20 kg?
Hand design and runtime are not published.
Does Foundation sell or lease outside the US?
